 > Write 200 words about moss. End by asking which moss I like best?

 The Quiet Life of Moss

 Moss is a small, resilient plant often overlooked in the rush of daily life. Found in damp forests, shaded sidewalks, and rocky crevices, moss thrives in environments where other plants struggle. It
 lacks true roots, absorbing moisture and nutrients directly from the air and rain. This adaptability makes it a symbol of endurance and quiet beauty.

 Moss plays a vital role in ecosystems. It helps retain moisture, stabilizes soil, and provides habitat for tiny insects and amphibians. Its
